title: The Leaked Tomato Trellis Plan
intro: Someone has passed the community garden's secret tomato trellis design to the rival allotment across the road, and the blueprint is nowhere to be found.

suspects.name: Hugo
suspects.line: The rival allotment? Never heard of them. Pass the hose.

suspects.name: Otis
suspects.line: Sure, I was near the compost. Smelled wonderful there.

suspects.name: Lena
suspects.line: I only came to drop off seedlings. Ten minutes, tops.

suspects.name: Priya
suspects.line: I was at the greenhouse all morning, honest.

suspects.name: Marisol
suspects.line: I've been weeding the beds since breakfast. Ask anyone.

clues.text: A green bandana was snagged on the potting shed hook, and its knot still looks freshly tied. The thief wore it while slipping away.
A footprint and a smear of dust show the culprit did not come through here. Whoever left the blueprint was never seen near the greenhouse at all.
A wide brim cap was left hanging on the gate latch, but its owner was across the garden at the time. Its wearer is cleared of the leak.
The watering can handle is clean and dry, with no soil on it. Whoever carried the blueprint did not have soil-stained hands.
